questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bats are balls.

All balls are wickets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wickets are balls.

II. All bats are wickets.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4921d864d470b0f0f9e34530192fae3bb937ba0c73da05145caebc01741a7c1.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All wickets are balls → Does not follow (As all balls are wickets. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) All bats are wickets&nb

questions.question: Seven friends, Gauri, Vinod, Ridima, Jiya, Ritik, Vishal and Karishma, are sitting on a circular bench, facing towards the centre but not necessarily in the same order. Vinod and Jiya are not the neighbours of Ritik. Karishma is sitting third to the left of Ritik. Gauri is sitting to the immediate right of Karishma. Ridima is sitting to the immediate left of Ritik. Who is sitting second to the right of Gauri?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven friends, Gauri, Vinod, Ridima, Jiya, Ritik, Vishal and Karishma, are sitting on a circular bench, facing towards the centre.

1) Karishma is sitting third to the left of Ritik.

2) Gauri is sitting to the immediate right of Karishma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffd55fe5fb83284e07d3513cd162a884e8ecff72b346e4fc31072ed5f3d58a57.png] 

3) Ridima is sitting to the immediate left of Ritik.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c85a2eb794b98e280602b6c68a61edc50de8d52975bad34666cff4fc2e91cc.png] 

4) Vinod and Jiya are not the neighbours of Ritik.

After positioning Vinod and Jiya only one position is left which will be occupied by only person left i.e. Vishal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cf882ca8ba357b49f1ef331d88974304f891b85b00faeab7b158034d36c2061.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Ritik is sitting second to the right of Gauri.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷ and ÷ means +, what is the value of the following expression?

8 – 2 + 6 × 3 ÷ 5
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 8 – 2 + 6 × 3 ÷ 5 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 −
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 8 × 2 − __**6 ÷ 3**__ + 5 = ?

⇒ __**8 × 2**__ − 2 + 5 = ?

⇒ __**16**__ − 2 __**+ 5**__ = ?

⇒ __**21 − 2**__ = 19.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8bc1ac1a6cb93320654c9e83b4510c59754f084bcb1c28be541fb66d03f79a.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/883d3de3beb0afe0eb5db5d0b1e4442c899e58678f6cc6a0fcee67734882830b.png] 

2) Number of triangles = (Number of parts × Number of diagonals)

= 4 × 2 ⇒ 8 

Here, as there are two same parts, therefore '8 + 8' = 16 triangles

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93c5fa8f4d98d0eeacfa11a3c4160d8bdd975fc36bf538aa51ee20af2597c825.png] 

3) Number of triangles as marked = 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68abc17519bbd24fcdfe3ef629996b60a879b77bc81f396f260cbad4d2d5a90a.png] 

Thus, total number of triangles are 3 + 16 + 4 = 23

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
